fields.label: Navbar Brand
fields.description: Logo and name shown on the navbar, next to the app logo and on every page bar.

fields.label: Brand Name
fields.description: E.g. your company name. Also used as the footer's "Powered by" name unless you set one.

fields.label: Show on Page Bars
fields.description: Also show the logo and name in the bar at the top of every page (hidden on small screens).

fields.label: Brand Logo
fields.description: Square mark, shown at 22px. It sits on the navbar color, so use a light / white version on dark colors.

fields.label: App Identity
fields.description: Saved to Website Settings and Navbar Settings when changed here.

fields.label: App Title
fields.description: Browser tab title and app name.

fields.label: App Logo
fields.description: Login page and sidebar / desktop logo.

fields.label: Favicon
fields.description: Browser tab icon (.ico, .png or .svg).

fields.label: Splash Image
fields.description: Shown while Desk is loading.

fields.label: Primary Color
fields.description: Buttons, links, checkboxes, focus rings and selections. A full shade scale is generated from it, and link shades are picked to stay readable.

fields.label: Button Text Color
fields.description: Label color on primary buttons. Leave empty to pick white or dark automatically for the best contrast.

fields.label: Background Tint
fields.description: Brand Tinted gives the grays, borders and dark mode a hint of the primary color.

fields.label: Login Page Background
fields.description: Leave empty for the darkest shade of the primary color.

fields.label: Gradient Start
fields.description: With Solid, this is the navbar color.

fields.label: Gradient End
fields.description: Also fills the sidebar header.

fields.label: Navbar Text Color
fields.description: Text and icons on the navbar, page bars and the active sidebar item.

fields.label: Font
fields.options:
Manrope
Inter
Poppins
Roboto
Open Sans
Lato
Nunito
DM Sans
Plus Jakarta Sans
Outfit
System Default
fields.description: Loaded from Google Fonts. System Default uses the device's own font and loads nothing.

fields.label: Corner Style
fields.description: Roundness of buttons, inputs, cards and dialogs.
The bar at the bottom of every Desk page. Use {year} for the current year and {brand} for the Brand Name.

fields.label: Use Custom HTML
fields.description: Replace the whole footer with your own HTML.

fields.label: Copyright Text
fields.description: Left side. Hidden on phones.

fields.label: Powered By Name
fields.description: Leave empty to use the Brand Name.

fields.label: Powered By Link
fields.description: Optional. Makes the name a link.

fields.label: Right Link Text
fields.description: E.g. www.example.com. Leave empty to show the link address.

fields.label: Custom Footer HTML
fields.description: Placed inside the footer bar. {year} and {brand} are replaced.

fields.label: Show Light / Dark Toggle
fields.description: Moon / sun button in the navbar and page bars.

fields.label: Custom CSS
fields.description: Loaded after the theme on Desk and website pages. Theme variables are available, e.g. var(--tm-brand-400).
